تلتزمي (form VIII)
# تَلْتَزِمِي (taltazimī) /tal.ta.zi.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# تُلْتَزَمِي (tultazamī) /tul.ta.za.miː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
